spanish: Y envió a los jóvenes de hijos de Israel, y subieron holocaustos, y sacrificaron sacrificios de pazes a Jehová, toros.

findings.issue: Both nouns are absolute; 'de pazes' smooths the juxtaposition into a genitive quality phrase. The peace-offering sense and plural remain.

notes: Person, number, hiphil object, cognate sacrifice, Jehová, and final toros match the tokens.
